The red card curse
A RED CARD
IN BOTH LEGS.
SAME FOUL. 🟥🟥
LEG 1 · 44'
Pau Cubarsi 🟥
Foul on Giuliano Simeone from behind. Yellow → Red via VAR. DOGSO.
LEG 2 · 83'
Eric Garcia 🟥
Foul on Sørloth from behind. Yellow → Red via VAR. DOGSO.
Both defenders. Both fouling from behind. Both upgraded from yellow to red via VAR. Both Giuliano Simeone involved. Barca defenders — don't chase him.
📊 This tie: Barca played 155 minutes with 10 men across both legs. They still scored 2 goals and created multiple big chances. Imagine 11 vs 11.
